scope: Independent read-only exact production delta, integrity/determinism/concurrency design and targeted test assertions. Reviewer ran no measured workloads/tests and changed no production/tests/dependencies.

exact_delta_proof.method: Recompute full canonical inventory digest using current bytes for every input except replacing graph/engine.py and filesystem/io.py in memory with the previously source640/source47-byte-proven retained subset bytes. Reconstructs exact source47 fingerprint.

integrity_dispositions.evidence: io.py read_json_object_with_sha256 calls ensure_no_filesystem_links, reads bytes once, strictly _decode_json on that same buffer, verifies object root, and hashes that same buffer. Existing read_json/read_json_object code remains unchanged. No second-read or mtime/inode shortcut.

engine._load_state always reads current manifest and strictly reads/parses graph, then ProjectGraph.model_validate(document) before proof selection. No graph model, raw buffer or parsed dictionary is stored in the proof. Repeated returned nested metadata remains detached from subsequent loads.

proof = self._graph_digest_proof captures the tuple once before reading current documents; hit comparison and canonical digest use that same local proof. Other concurrent load may replace or clear the engine proof but cannot mix rawA with digestB within this load.

Current manifest and graph schema/parser versions and manifest.graph_sha256 comparison still run on every load after selecting a canonical digest. Only successful complete validation populates the proof; mismatch clears it.

Raw document must explicitly contain generated_at to hit or install a proof. ProjectGraph.generated_at uses utc_now default; omitted field forces fresh canonical serialization/digest and leaves no proof. ProjectGraph/GraphNode/GraphEdge other current defaults and validators reviewed are deterministic for a byte-identical explicit-timestamp document.

Missing files clear proof and returnNone; caught invalid IO/JSON/model/hash/version failures clear proof and returnNone; PolicyDeniedError clears proof and propagates. Existing outer is_file preflight remains outside the try as before; unusual preflight exceptions are not a new proof authorization path. Restored valid content must validate again after cleared proof.

One tuple of two SHA strings perengine adds negligible retained proof data, with no graph/data/global cache, persisted format/schema/parser change, altered graph SHA semantics, relaxed path/approval/control authority or lock deadline change.

targeted_tests_reviewed_not_executed_by_: test_digest_proof_reuses_validation_but_never_returned_models verifies one initial canonical digest, fresh detached models, same-size restored-mtime tampering rejection, failure invalidation and valid restoration recomputation.
test_digest_proof_checks_fresh_manifest_and_invalidates_failures covers changed manifest digest, deleted graph, duplicate key and nonfinite literal.

test_digest_proof_is_coherent_when_another_load_updates_it injects exact interleaving replacement between captured proof and completed graph read; local tuple remains coherent. This is a deterministic interleaving test, not an OS thread workload.

test_digest_proof_cannot_reuse_volatile_timestamp_default seeds a tempting rawSHA proof after removing generated_at and verifies canonical digest still runs, invalid state is rejected and proof remains cleared.
test_digest_proof_clears_and_preserves_link_policy_error verifies propagated policy exception and invalidation.
test_json_object_digest_uses_exact_single_decoded_read makes a second read return different valid bytes, asserting only one read and corresponding decodedvalue/SHA.

benefit_scope.supported: Repeated ProjectGraphEngine.load/refresh and ProjectContextBuilder.build using the same retained instance after the first eligible successful load can avoid repeated canonical graph serialization/hash. The held-out helper reuses these instances, so its warm/context measurements can reflect this bounded benefit.
sdk_mcp_no_cross_request_benefit: sdk.py:223 constructs new ProjectContextBuilder per context request
sdk.py:233 constructs new ProjectGraphEngine per graph request
benefit_scope.index_limit: ProjectIndex keeps one graph engine at construction (service.py:64), but search does not invoke it. rebuild calls graph.rebuild(force=True) and writes a new graph/generated_at, so ordinary repeated search or rebuild is not a comparable unchanged warm-proof use case. Do not advertise generic ProjectIndex search/rebuild speedup from this change.
benefit_scope.not_claimed: No SDK/MCP engine lifetime changes, cross-request caching, measured improvement yet, universal primary product latency fix or tail cure.
